# Zenless Zone Zero Website DNA — Technical Handbook

Published 4 October 2026 · Author: Calyndrae · Live edition: https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/en-us/news/7013/ · Repository: https://github.com/Calyndrae/Zenless-Zone-Zero-Site-DNA

## Preface

### Goal

Describe one website, the official **Zenless Zone Zero** site at https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/zh-cn/main, at the depth of its public pages — the home page, the character, video, news and world pages, a news article, the company documents, on both its desktop tree and its phone tree — so completely that a reader can build a **child site of the same family**: the same colours, type, rhythm, components, motion, sound and rendering behaviour, from the fixed header to the loader.

The purpose is to see clearly how the site is constructed, not to copy its content.

### Explicitly out of scope

• Pages beyond depth 1 on other hosts: the payment and guide pages, the account pages (their links are recorded)  
• Other locales (the same build serves them; zh-cn is the one captured)  
• The game, its lore and its artwork as subjects in themselves  
• Any claim about server-side code: only shipped responses and client code are evidence  
• Invented values of any kind: nothing in this handbook is estimated, rounded or assumed

If a statement is not read from shipped code, measured in a browser on the live site, or marked as interpretation, it does not belong in this handbook.

### Asset source

The markup, stylesheets, scripts, fonts, images and sounds reproduced here were loaded from the live site and its CDNs on 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-04 and belong to **HoYoverse / COGNOSPHERE**. They are reproduced solely for the study of the site's construction. Nothing in this handbook is a release of those assets.

### Explanation

The handbook is intentionally narrower than a design system. By fixing the subject to one site at one date and admitting only three kinds of evidence, it creates a controlled record in which every colour, size, easing and timing can be traced to a file or a measurement. "Nearly the same looking site" is a statement about that record: build from the rules, specimens and code printed here and the result shares the site's DNA; it does not become the site.

## Reading this edition

This is a technical handbook, not a status report. The evidence cutoff is **2026-10-04**, when the live site was captured and measured; the site may change after that date. Four labels mark every claim. **OBSERVED** means read directly from shipped code, stylesheets or server responses. **MEASURED** means reported by headless Chromium driving the live site: clicks, hovers, scrolls, keyboard, resizes and the real-time calculations re-run in the page. **INFERRED** is interpretation and never a fact. **RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** is a transferable instruction derived from the three above.

Where a component could be captured verbatim from the live page it is shown rendered with the site's own stylesheets (the 65 modules printed in Appendix A) at the 1440-wide scale (1rem = 56.25px), followed by its exact markup. The only normalisation is the removal of inline opacity, transform and transition values that Swiper and GSAP write during motion, so each specimen is in its settled state.

Short excerpts of the reconstructed, readable JavaScript sit next to the behaviour they produce; the complete modules are in Appendix B. Minified identifiers were renamed scope-aware; values, strings and control flow are unchanged. Vendor libraries (Vue 2.7, Nuxt 2, vue-router, Vuex, vue-meta, Swiper 4.5.1, GSAP with ScrollTrigger, axios, lodash, date-fns, vant, pdf.js, vuescroll, firebase, the HoYoverse SDKs) are identified, not reprinted.

Large machine-readable archives — the CSS rule database, colour and typography tables, captures, network manifest, module maps — are not reprinted. They are hosted with the live edition of this handbook at https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com and listed with sizes in Appendix C; every link in the chapters resolves there. The same host carries the originals archive and the self-contained mirror described in the originals chapter: every file the pages load, every CMS answer, the SDK scripts and the record media within the size budget, with the original application served from them on both trees. The source repository is https://github.com/Calyndrae/Zenless-Zone-Zero-Site-DNA. The supplied template provides the page layout: its cover, front-matter, body and acknowledgements roles and colours are kept; its wordmark is not.

**Author:** Calyndrae.

Use the linked contents pages to open any section directly; the word Contents in every footer returns to them.

## Notice

The website studied here, its name, characters, artwork, music, fonts, code and all other material belong to HoYoverse / COGNOSPHERE and their licensors. This handbook reproduces parts of that material for the purpose of describing how the site is built. It is not endorsed by, affiliated with or published on behalf of the site's owners.

The readable JavaScript in Appendix B is a reconstruction: the shipped minified modules with their identifiers renamed for reading. It is not the site's source code and must not be presented as such. The stylesheets in Appendix A are the shipped css-loader modules reformatted.

The page layout, beige front matter, body pages and acknowledgements treatment are adapted from the supplied template. The template's publisher did not author, publish or endorse this handbook, and no mark of theirs appears in it.

Measurements describe the site as it answered on 2026-10-03/04 to one headless Chromium build in one container (no H.264 decoder, no GPU, no real pointer). Where that environment limited a measurement — the overlay video players opened but created no player element, and the character stage did not react to synthetic clicks — the limit is stated in place, and the mirror on the hosted site renders those parts in any normal browser from the archived files.

## 01 Scope, evidence rules and how to read this page

_Chapter 01 · 2 observed · 0 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

This handbook describes the Zenless Zone Zero official website at **https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/zh-cn/main** to a depth of one navigation step, on both of its trees: the desktop tree under /zh-cn/… and the phone tree under /m/zh-cn/… that the site itself serves to mobile user agents. 17 desktop pages and 9 mobile pages were captured in headless Chromium on 2026-10-03; every number, class name, colour and file name in these chapters comes from the shipped code, from the responses the pages received, or from measurements taken in that browser.

**OBSERVED** — Desktop pages captured: redemption, /zh-cn/character?id=166076, /zh-cn/company/privacy, /zh-cn/company/terms, /zh-cn/main, /zh-cn/news, /zh-cn/news/166475, /zh-cn/news/166476, /zh-cn/news/166496, /zh-cn/news/166497, /zh-cn/news/166498, /zh-cn/news/166535, /zh-cn/video, /zh-cn/world, /zh-cn/world/102173, /zh-cn/world/102257, /zh-cn/world/102370.

**OBSERVED** — Mobile pages captured (iPhone user agent, 390×844 CSS px, device pixel ratio 2): /m/zh-cn/character, /m/zh-cn/company/privacy, /m/zh-cn/company/terms, /m/zh-cn/main, /m/zh-cn/news, /m/zh-cn/news/166535, /m/zh-cn/video, /m/zh-cn/world, /m/zh-cn/world/102370.

How to read: **OBSERVED** = read from shipped code or responses · **MEASURED** = reported by headless Chromium · **INFERRED** = interpretation, never a fact · **RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** = transferable instruction derived from the above. Where a value is given in rem, the root font-size is the one the site computes from the viewport (chapter on rendering scale); the bracketed pixel values are for a 1440 px wide desktop window and a 390 px wide phone.

What is not in scope: the pages behind the "更多" (more) menu that live on other hosts (充值 at sdk.hoyoverse.com/payment, 攻略 at act.hoyolab.com), the account pages at account.hoyoverse.com that open in an iframe when the user icon is clicked, and the game itself. The redemption page at /redemption is on this host but is a separate build (it loads its own bundles from act.hoyoverse.com); it is described where the nav reaches it and archived with the originals.

### The header navigation and where each entry goes

**MEASURED** — Header entries at 1440 wide: 首页 · 角色介绍 · 影像资料 · 新闻资讯 · 设定档案 · 更多 · 立即下载. Clicking 角色介绍 / 影像资料 / 新闻资讯 / 设定档案 changed the route to /zh-cn/character, /zh-cn/video, /zh-cn/news, /zh-cn/world without a document reload (performance navigation entries stayed at 1), in 1971 ms, 1807 ms, 1649 ms, 1425 ms from click to route change. The logo click from /zh-cn/video returned to /zh-cn/main.

**MEASURED** — Hovering 更多 opens a sub-menu with 3 links: 兑换码 → https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/redemption; 充值 → https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/payment; 攻略 → https://act.hoyolab.com/zzz/event/e20240601-guide-c0k2vt/index.html.

### Content comes from one CMS API

**OBSERVED** — Every list and article on the site is fetched at run time from https://sg-public-api-static.hoyoverse.com/content_v2_user/app/3e9196a4b9274bd7 with three GET endpoints: /getContentList (paged lists of a channel), /getContent (one record with its neighbours when iAround=1) and /getChildTree (the sub-channels of a channel). The parameter names are the API's: iChanId, iPageSize, iPage, iInfoId, iAround, sLangKey.

**OBSERVED** — A list answer is {retcode, message, data:{iTotal, list:[…]}}; each record carries sChanId[], sTitle, sIntro, sUrl, sAuthor, sContent (HTML), sExt (a JSON string of named images and fields), dtStartTime, dtEndTime, dtCreateTime, iInfoId, sTagName[], sCategoryName, sSign. /getContent adds around:{prevContent, nextContent}. The news index reported iTotal = 1535 records on 2026-10-03.

**RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — Build the child site as an SPA shell plus a content API with the same three verbs and the same record shape; keep the channel ids as configuration (the constants module shows the complete map), keep text in per-language JSON dictionaries, and keep the phone tree as separate routes rather than a responsive variant of the desktop pages.

## 03 Technical structure: Nuxt 2 shell, webpack 4 chunks, injected CSS, SDKs

_Chapter 03 · 4 observed · 0 measured · 0 inferred · 1 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Stack read from the shipped code: Nuxt 2 in SPA mode (window.__NUXT__ holds only {config:{_app:{basePath:"/",assetsPath:"/_nuxt/",cdnURL:null}}}, no server-rendered state), Vue 2.7.4 runtime, vue-router, Vuex, vue-meta (the data-n-head attributes in the shell), webpack 4 (window.webpackJsonp chunk loading, public path "/_nuxt/"), Swiper 4.5.1 for every carousel, GSAP with ScrollTrigger for scroll-driven motion, axios behind a HoYoverse request layer, lodash, date-fns, vant and pdf.js inside the vendor bundle, and the HoYoverse SDKs loaded as separate scripts: jquery 1.11.1 (dependency of the SDK scripts), hoyoverse-account-sdk, hoyoverse-footer, analysis v2, and the APM helper.

### The shell (one file for every route)

The server answers every path with the same 8 KB document: meta tags, the loading placeholder with an inline <style> element, the SDK scripts, the four entry scripts and the APM bootstrap. The archived copy is [original/shell-response.html](https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/original/shell-response.html); its head script order is the one below.

## 04 Rendering scale: the rem adapter (100 × clientWidth ÷ design width)

_Chapter 04 · 2 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 1 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Every length in the stylesheets is in rem. A plugin in the app bundle (module 326) sets the root font-size from the viewport: fontSize = 100 × clientWidth ÷ designWidth, with the design width 2560 for the desktop tree and 750 for the phone tree. On desktop the client width is clamped to [1440, 2560] before the division (minScaleWidth 1440, maxFillWidth 2560), so a window narrower than 1440 px keeps the 1440 layout and scrolls horizontally rather than shrinking; on phones the height (designHeight 1334) is used in landscape. The plugin also adds the class pc or mo to , adds hairlines when the device pixel ratio is at least 2, and only then sets #__nuxt visible.

**Code — readable/rem---device.326.js lines 1–14 (readable reconstruction of the shipped module; values and control flow unchanged):**

```
/**
 * rem---device — readable reconstruction of webpack module 326 (chunk 8c4c131.js)
 * Original: https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/_nuxt/8c4c131.js
 *
 * Nuxt client plugin that sets up responsive rem scaling (a lib-flexible variant) and device detection. It reads device info from a device-utils module (`getDeviceType`, `ios`, `android`, `samsungTablet`, `getOrient`), adds a `mo` or `pc` class to `<html>`, and computes the root font-size from `clientWidth` against a design width (750x1334 for mobile with landscape handling, 2560 with min-scale 1440 for PC), correcting for older Android Chrome (<79) font-size clamping, recalculating on `resize`/`pageshow`, adding a `hairlines` class on high-DPR screens, and revealing `#__nuxt`. It injects `$flex` (a getter for `rem`, `deviceType`/`device`, `clientType`, `pc`, `mobile`/`mo`, `samsungTablet`) and `$qs` (the qs library).
 *
 * Exports (minified key → meaning):
 *   a → the Nuxt plugin function (context, inject) registering $flex and $qs
 *
 * Identifiers were renamed scope-aware from the minified bundle; values, strings, class names and
 * control flow are unchanged. Library aliases resolve to the module map in source/MODULE-MAP.md.
 */
// module 326 from 8c4c131.js
// deps: 224, 556, 204, 321, 299
```

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2560×1440 | 2560 | 100px | 100px | no |
| 1920×1080 | 1920 | 75px | 75px | no |
| 1440×900 | 1440 | 56.25px | 56.25px | no |
| 1280×720 | 1280 | 56.25px | 50px | yes → 56.25px |
| 1024×768 | 1024 | 56.25px | 40px | yes → 56.25px |
| 800×600 | 800 | 56.25px | 31.25px | yes → 56.25px |

**MEASURED** — So 1rem = 56.25px at 1440 wide, 75px at 1920, 100px at 2560 (the design canvas); 1rem = 52px on a 390 px phone. The design files were drawn at 2560 × 1440 (desktop) and 750 × 1334 (phone): a value of .46rem in the CSS is 46 px in the design and 25.88 px on a 1440 window.

**OBSERVED** — The base stylesheet still declares html{font-size:14px} (module 202, the vendor reset); the inline style the plugin writes on  overrides it on every page load and on every resize and pageshow event.

**RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — Use the same adapter: author in rem against a 2560-wide (desktop) and 750-wide (phone) canvas, set html font-size = 100 × clientWidth ÷ designWidth on load, resize and pageshow, clamp the desktop width to [1440, 2560], and hide the app root until the first value is written.

**MEASURED** — On the home page at 1440 × 900 the fixed header is 1440 × 56 px (1rem high) at the top, the sidebar pager sits fixed at the right edge (46.125px × 201.375px), and the sections scroll beneath them; the loading overlay (.zzz-loading in the shell, then the Vue .loading component) covers the viewport at z-index 997 until the page component has mounted.

**INFERRED** — The order is: content (auto) → sticky/fixed page chrome (header 99, sidebar 99, backTop) → SDK overlays (account popup, cookie tips, toast) → nuxt-progress 999999 → the user-model loading overlay at 2147483646/7, which is the request layer's own blocking spinner.

## 08 Columns, spacing scale and section rhythm

_Chapter 08 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 1 inferred · 1 rules_

**MEASURED** — At 1440 × 900 the desktop content column is 1080 px wide (19.2rem) centred in the 1440 window: the header inner wrapper, every home section and the footer social bar share it. The home sections stack to 4835 px: index 865 px, character 690 px, video 667 px, news 687 px, world 599 px, feature 861 px; header 56 px, footer 424 px. The news article column is 12.8rem (720 px at 1440) with 2.6rem padding above.

**OBSERVED** — Spacing values that recur in the stylesheets: margin: 0 auto (31); margin: 0 (21); padding: 0 (19); margin-left: 0 (15); padding: 0 .14rem (12); margin-left: .26rem (11); margin-top: .6rem (10); margin-top: 1rem (10); margin-top: .4rem (10); margin-top: .1rem (9); margin-right: .22rem (8); margin-left: .2rem (7); margin-right: 0 (7); margin-top: .7rem (7); padding: 0 .2rem (6); padding: 0 .1rem (6); margin-top: 1.1rem (6); margin-top: 0 (6); margin-bottom: .1rem (5); margin: .9rem 0 (5); padding: 0 .4rem (5); margin-right: .02rem (4); margin-top: .2rem (4); margin: 0 !important (4).

**INFERRED** — The rhythm is built on tenths of a rem (0.1rem = 10 design px): .1/.2/.4/.6/1rem margins between blocks, .14/.26rem gutters inside controls; sections on the home page are not equal in height but each is a full composition that the sidebar pager scrolls to as a unit.

**RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — Keep a 1080-px-wide (19.2rem) centred column for desktop chrome and lists, a 12.8rem reading column for articles, and spacing in multiples of .1rem.

## 09 Header: logo, navigation, more-menu, download, music, share, account

_Chapter 09 · 1 observed · 5 measured · 0 inferred · 1 rules_

**OBSERVED** — The header is the layout component header-bar (module 348, readable source): a fixed bar 1rem high across the full width, with a 19.2rem inner wrapper that holds the logo (two images, logo-big and logo-sm, swapped with the logoBig/logoSmall transitions as the page scrolls), the left navigation (ltNav from getLtNavs: 首页, 角色介绍, 影像资料, 新闻资讯, 设定档案, 更多, 立即下载) and the right tools (rtNav: the background-music toggle m-audio-player, the share button, the account icon). The nav items are divs with click handlers (handleNavClick → $router.push), not links, so they do not appear in the page's anchor list.

**MEASURED** — At 1440 × 900 the header box is 1440 × 56 px; the inner wrapper is 1080 px; nav labels are font-size 11.25px, color rgb(0, 0, 0), font-family "Helvetica neue", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Microsoft YaHei", Arial, "sans-serif"; the logo image is 129 × 30 px; the BGM, share and login icons are 33 × 33 px at x = 1080, 1142 and 1196.

![home page at 1440 × 900 with the header, hero and sidebar](https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/capture/pages/zh-cn_main/desktop-1440x900.png)

**Specimen — header inner wrapper (nav + tools) — the bar itself is position:fixed, so its inner wrapper is embedded**

The nav-content divs are the clickable entries; the sub-menu of 更多 is in the DOM at rest and shown on hover.

**MEASURED** — Hovering 更多: the sub-menu (.nav-content-sub) becomes block with 3 entries (兑换码, 充值, 攻略); 兑换码 and 充值 are plain links to /redemption and /payment, 攻略 opens the HoYoLAB guide.

**MEASURED** — The music toggle: store.bgmMuted was false before the click and false after it in headless Chromium (no audio element exists in the DOM; the player is the @me/audio library behind m-audio-player, and the muted choice is persisted in localStorage as napSeaBgAudioOfficial={"createdTime":1791070694320,"cacheTime":0,"data":false}). The icon class is m-audio-player__icon with the heartbeat animation while active. The track itself is https://webstatic.hoyoverse.com/upload/static-resource/2022/04/19/aeefeb96a2a294cf1d7ab7324fd9a492_568718570249589416.mp3 (3.4 MB).

**MEASURED** — Hovering the share icon shows .share__panel (display block, height 200.75px) with the social items of the footer SDK (Twitter, Youtube, TikTok, Discord, Instagram, HoYoLAB, Twitch, Telegram).

**MEASURED** — Clicking the account icon opens the HoYoverse account SDK in an iframe: https://account.hoyoverse.com/login-platform/index.html?st=https%3A%2F%2Fzenless.hoyoverse.com%2Fzh-cn%2Fvideo&token_typ.

```
.header { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 99; width: 100%; height: 1rem; background-color: #000 }
```

```
getActiveSectionIndex: function (scrollPosition) {
  var sections = this.$gsap.utils.toArray(".section");
  if (!sections.length) return 0;
  for (
    var probeY = scrollPosition + 0.5 * window.innerHeight,
      lastSectionIndex = sections.length - 1,
      sectionIdx = lastSectionIndex;
    sectionIdx >= 0;
    sectionIdx--
  ) {
    var sectionTop = sections[sectionIdx].offsetTop,
      sectionBottom = sectionTop + sections[sectionIdx].offsetHeight;
    if (probeY >= sectionTop && probeY < sectionBottom) return sectionIdx;
  }
  return probeY >= sections[lastSectionIndex].offsetTop ? lastSectionIndex : 0;
},
setActivePageIndex: function (nextPageIndex) {
  this.activePageIndex !== nextPageIndex &&
    ((this.activePageIndex = nextPageIndex),
    this.$store.commit("setHomeSection", mi18nModule.e[nextPageIndex].link));
},
updateActiveIndexFromScroll: function () {
  if (this.needUpdate && !this.isProgrammaticScroll) {
    var currentScrollTop = document.body.scrollTop || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    this.setActivePageIndex(this.getActiveSectionIndex(currentScrollTop));
  }
```

**RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — Section pagination = a fixed list of numbers bound to a store value that both the click handler and the scroll listener write; compute the active section from the section offsets on every scroll event.

## 17 Home feature section: concept block, feature fade swiper, concept video

_Chapter 17 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

**OBSERVED** — The last section (section-feature) pairs home-feature__list (6 slides, effect fade, slidesPerView 1, loop true, speed 300 ms, no autoplay) with a concept block: section__concept-title (Drip Fest 2025), section__concept-icon, and section__concept-video (a TV-shaped frame with a play button that opens the concept video; conceptUrl in the page component). ## 18 Footer: back-to-top, social bar, subscription widget, HoYoverse footer and locale picker

_Chapter 18 · 1 observed · 2 measured · 0 inferred · 1 rules_

**OBSERVED** — The footer is three stacked parts: footer__wrap with the backTop button (module 347; class light on light sections) and footer__socialbar, which the footer SDK fills with the me-media-icon row (Twitter, YouTube, TikTok, Discord, Instagram, HoYoLAB, Twitch, Telegram, Reddit) plus a copy-link button (me-hover-btn with two stacked images, normal and hover); footer-crm with the hyv-crm subscription form (e-mail subscription widget of the CRM SDK); and the HoYoverse footer (hy-footer, hashed CSS-module classes such as link-1VLT0O and locale-selector-3HQCGC) with the product logo, the legal links (隐私政策, 使用者协议, 关于我们, 联系我们, 客服中心), the trademark notice and the language selector.

| --- | --- |
| 阅读详情>> | https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/zh-cn/company/privacy |
| 隐私政策 | https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/zh-cn/company/privacy |
| 使用者协议 | https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/zh-cn/company/terms |
| 关于我们 | https://www.hoyoverse.com/about-us?utm_source=zzz&utm_medium=footer |
| 联系我们 | mailto:zzz_cs@hoyoverse.com |
| 服务中心 | https://cs.hoyoverse.com/static/hoyoverse-new-csc-service-hall-fe/index.html?page_id=19&login_type=visitor&game_biz=platform_hyvpass&lang=zh-cn&utm_source=zzz&utm_medium=footer |

**MEASURED** — Hovering the YouTube icon: {"class":"me-media-icon-item media-icon-Youtube","transform":"none","background-color":"rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)","transition":"all"}; the copy button swaps its normal/hover images ({"normal":{"class":"me-hover-btn__img me-hover-btn__img-normal","opacity":"0","display":"block"},"hover":{"class":"me-hover-btn__img me-hover-btn__img-hover","o).

**MEASURED** — Clicking the locale selector lists: 中文(简体) 中文(繁體) Deutsch En · 中文(简体) · 中文(繁體) · Deutsch · English · Español · Français · Indonesia · 日本語 · 한국어 · Português · Pусский · ภาษาไทย · Tiếng Việt.

**RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — Keep the three-part footer: a site-owned social/back-top strip, an SDK-owned subscription block and an SDK-owned corporate footer with the language picker; a child site owns only the first part and the containers.

## 19 Character page (/zh-cn/character): fade stage, pagination, voice player, faction rail

_Chapter 19 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 1 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Route lang-character (module 1439, readable source; styles module 1330 plus the character-block styles of 1250). The page reads the character list (channel 287, iPageSize 200) and the camp list (channel 286) and keeps the current character in the query (?id=; the capture landed on ?id=166076). Three Swiper instances: cha-swiper (62 slides, effect fade, slidesPerView 1, loop false, direction horizontal, speed 300 ms) shows one character with its art (character-cover), name (character-info-name, English name in Mont-Heavy), CV line (character-info-prop), quote and description (character-info-desc) and the voice player (character-voice-player with character-voice-btn and the language switcher character-voice-lang-switcher); cha-pagination-swiper (2 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView 3, loop false, direction horizontal, speed 300 ms) is the arrow/pagination row; side-camp-swiper (60 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView auto, loop true, direction vertical, speed 300 ms) is the vertical faction rail on the right (side-camp-item with icon and name), expanded by 更多阵营 (side-camp-expand-btn).

**MEASURED** — At 1440 × 900 the page body is 1210 px high; the active character was "赛维里安·洛威尔 Severian Lowell"; the faction rail listed 20 factions: 弗林特工坊, 空域巡戍局, 达识结社, 外务筹策局, 法厄同, 都市秩序部, 妄想天使, 坎卜斯黑枝, 怪啖屋, 云岿山, 反舌鸟, 防卫军·白银小队…; the page background is linear-gradient(rgb(232, 232, 232), rgb(232, 232, 232) 545.062px, rgb(239, 239, 239) 545.062px, rgb(239, 239, 239) 100%). Clicking a pagination item, the voice button, a faction and pressing ArrowRight in headless Chromium did not move the fade swiper (activeIndex stayed 0; the voice button toggled its --progress custom property between 99.4337% → 44.3312% (19–1431 ms, 6001 frames)), which points at handlers bound to touch/pointer gestures on the swiper rather than plain clicks; the expand button exposed all 60 faction items.

![character page at 1440 × 900](https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/capture/pages/zh-cn_character/desktop-1440x900.png)

![faction rail expanded by 更多阵营](https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/capture/interactions/character-camps-expanded.png)

```html
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap">——谨慎观察周围后，说话声越来越小、又陡然大叫起来的希希芙</p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap; min-height: 1.5em">
            </p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap">「大家都说，『赛维里安·洛威尔长官是所有治安官的榜样』。但我…好吧，虽然听起来有点可笑，但他不是我的榜样。如果『他能按照自己说好的时间回家』？那也不是！」</p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap">——赛斯</p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap; min-height: 1.5em">
            </p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap">「黑枝的档案里有他的资料。呃，这会不会有点夸张…我知道要『避免与之发生冲突』，但也不用最大字号、红色字体，加粗标注三次吧？」</p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap">——菲欧妮</p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap; min-height: 1.5em">
            </p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap">「长官他…好像会在大家出外勤的时候，给我的番茄和青衣前辈的绿植浇水？虽然我没有证据。我暂时还无法想象和他讨论任何工作以外的问题…」</p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap">——朱鸢</p>
            <p style="white-space: pre-wrap; min-height: 1.5em">
            </p>
          </div>
          <div style="display: block; position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; z-index: -1000; pointer-events: none">
```

**RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — One record per slide with a fade transition; the thumbnail row and the faction rail are separate swipers synchronised through the component state; keep the active record in the URL query so a character page is linkable.

## 20 Video page (/zh-cn/video): latest slider, category tabs, paged grid, overlay player

_Chapter 20 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Route lang-video (module 1420, readable source; styles 1403, video-tag 1400, pager 1170). The page shows video-slider__latest (18 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView auto, loop true, direction horizontal, speed 300 ms) with six bullets, the tab row video-tab (最新 and the sub-channels of 1332 from getChildTree: 版本PV 1341, 角色EP&MV 1340, 角色PV 1339, 角色展示 1338; the tab is the ?category query), the grid video-list (nine video-list__item per page: banner, date in font-num, tag, title) and the pager mi-ho-yo-pager-rich (module 1174). Clicking an item opens the video-dialog with the record's video.

**MEASURED** — Tabs: 最新 → /zh-cn/video; 版本PV → /zh-cn/video?category=1341; 角色EP&MV → /zh-cn/video?category=1340; 角色PV → /zh-cn/video?category=1339; 角色展示 → /zh-cn/video?category=1338. Clicking 版本PV changed the route to /zh-cn/video?category=1341 and requested …/getContentList?iPageSize=9&iPage=1&iChanId=1341&sLangKey=zh-cn, the grid went from "《绝区零》洛克茜角色PV | 发条骑士" to "《绝区零》3.2版本PV | 她与她的隐秘往事" (7 items). Pager buttons: 1 2 3 4 5.

![video page at 1440 × 900](https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/capture/pages/zh-cn_video/desktop-1440x900.png)

## 21 News index (/zh-cn/news): latest slider, tabs, paged list

_Chapter 21 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Route lang-news (module 1416, readable source; styles 1396, news-tag 1160, pager 1170, section-nav 1135). Same skeleton as the video page: news-slider__latest (18 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView auto, loop true, direction horizontal, speed 300 ms), the tab row news-tab (最新 288, 新闻 295, 公告 296, 活动 297 — the ?category query), the list news-list of nine news-list__item (banner, date, news-tag, title, description) and the pager. The data is channel 288 with iPageSize 9; the tabs call the sub-channel with the same page size.

**MEASURED** — Tabs: 最新 → /zh-cn/news; 新闻 → /zh-cn/news?category=295; 公告 → /zh-cn/news?category=296; 活动 → /zh-cn/news?category=297. Clicking 公告: route /zh-cn/news?category=296, request …/getContentList?iPageSize=9&iPage=1&iChanId=296&sLangKey=zh-cn, first titles 「跛脚乌鸦奇探录」活动说明 / 「锵锵！球仔成长日记」活动说明 / 3.2版本限时频段（下期）. The next-page arrow requested …/getContentList?iPageSize=9&iPage=2&iChanId=296&sLangKey=zh-cn and the pager showed page 2. Clicking a banner navigated to /zh-cn/news/165997 (router push, requests …/getContent?iChanId=288&iAround=1&iInfoId=165997&sLangKey=zh-cn); the back button returned to /zh-cn/news. Pager at rest: 1 2 3 4 5 171 (22359).

## 22 News article (/zh-cn/news/:id) — the template this page runs in

_Chapter 22 · 2 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 1 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Route lang-news-id (module 1451, [readable source](#js-lang-news-1451-js); styles 1411). asyncData calls the news API getDetail({iInfoId, iChanId: 288, sLangKey}) → /getContent?…&iAround=1; a failed call redirects to the news index. The template: news-detail-back (a back-btn with arrow and 返回 / BACK), news-detail-wrapper → news-detail-container (12.8rem wide) → news-detail-article with news-detail__title (sTitle), news-detail__info (the breadcrumb 绝区零 > 新闻, the category news-tag, the date dtStartTime) and news-detail__content, which receives sContent as raw HTML (v-html). A section__foot decoration and a sticky backContainer with the backTop button follow, then the footer.

**OBSERVED** — The CMS editor emits p/span/strong/em/u/br/img/h4/a/table/td with inline white-space, text-align, line-height, font-size and min-height styles; the template styles img and video to max-width 100%, tables to full width with #c2c2c2 borders and a .table-wrapper scroll box, links to break-word. This handbook uses exactly that vocabulary.

**MEASURED** — Article page at 1440 × 900: title font-size 25.875px, font-weight 800, color rgb(34, 33, 34), line-height 33.6375px; info bar height 36px, background-color rgb(34, 33, 34), border-radius 18px, font-size 13.5px; content font-size 11.25px, line-height 16.875px, color rgb(34, 33, 34); container width 720px, padding-top —; page height 1630 px.

## 23 World page (/zh-cn/world) and world entries (/zh-cn/world/:id)

_Chapter 23 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Route lang-world (module 1441, readable source; styles 1406 with the slideToTop keyframes). The page is one Swiper (world__swiper: 9 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView auto, loop true, direction horizontal, speed 800 ms) of the three channel-290 entries looped to nine slides (world__slide → world__slide-container with a mask, a cover (cover-name with name-en and name, cover-summary) and a tape (world__slide-tape with tape-name)); prev/next arrows at the window edges; clicking the active slide (gotoDetail) pushes /zh-cn/world/. The slides enter with slideToTop (0.3 s, forwards) and carry isInitAnim.

**MEASURED** — Slides: Bangboo, The city life, Hollow (×3 for the loop). Next: activeIndex 3 → 4 over 828 ms (transition-duration 800ms, the slides translate by ±40.432rem and scale). Hovering the active slide: cover {"class":"world__slide-cover","opacity":"1","transform":"matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, -101.745, 0)"}, tape {"class":"world__slide-tape","opacity":"1","transform":"matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 100.789, 0)"}. Clicking it navigated to /zh-cn/world with ; the detail page (route lang-world-id, module 1452, styles 1413) renders world-detail-container with .

**OBSERVED** — The 兑换码 entry of the more-menu opens /redemption. It is not a Nuxt route: the server answers with a different document that loads its own bundles from act.hoyoverse.com/zzz/event/20240601-exchange-anchpz/ (vendors, styles, index) and a stylesheet, plus Vue 2.7.14 runtime, browser-tips, the account SDK and mihoyo-analysis from webstatic. ## 26 Phone tree: /m routes, the m-header and its menu, the rem adapter at 750

_Chapter 26 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 1 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Phones get a parallel site: the shell head script tests navigator.userAgent for phone/pad/Android/iPhone (and MacIntel with touch points, i.e. iPadOS) and rewrites the path to /m//…; the Nuxt router has an m-lang-* route for every desktop route (same page names with an m- prefix, separate chunks: 0eb4cff / fd57a96+df9cade+b5b7858+564bae5 / fd57a96+b5b7858+ded62d7 / fd57a96+b74c7e3+b5b7858+7ff8829+a9873dc / fd57a96+b74c7e3+b5b7858+f87ccae / fd57a96+b74c7e3+b5b7858+fcdddd8), and the mobile layout (module 551) mounts m-header-bar (module 349, styles 695) instead of header-bar. The rem adapter uses designWidth 750 (1rem = 52px at 390 wide), adds the class mo to , and the mobile stylesheets are separate modules (m-home-*, m-cha, m-news, m-video, m-world, m-section-nav).

**MEASURED** — /m/zh-cn/main at 390 × 844: 2423 px high, 261 class names, 54 style tags; root font-size 52px. Header parts: m-header__logo, m-header__download, m-audio-player, m-header__menu-btn, m-header__menu, m-header__menu-header, m-header__menu-close, m-header__menu-content, m-header__menu-links, m-header__menu-link. **RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — Serve phones a separate route tree with its own components and stylesheets chosen by user agent, not a responsive reflow; keep the same data, store and API.

## 27 Phone home: KV, section nav, character, video, news, world, feature, pre-register

_Chapter 27 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

**OBSERVED** — Route m-lang-main (module 1419, readable source): sections m-home-kv (KV with slogan, play and a fixed-position download aside), the m-section-nav numbers, m-home-character (62 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView auto, loop false nav + 62 slides, effect fade, slidesPerView 1, loop false list), m-home-video (9 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView 1, loop false), m-home-news (18 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView auto, loop true), m-home-world (9 slides, effect slide, slidesPerView auto, loop true), m-home-feature (6 slides, effect fade, slidesPerView 1, loop true) and the m-preregister block (toLanding). The page tracks scroll (onScroll → fixedPos) and resize (onResize) itself.

**MEASURED** — Section tops at 390 wide: index 57px (h 340), character 421px (h 297), video 740px (h 229), news 993px (h 229), world 1230px (h 229), feature 1459px (h 310). After scrolling to y = 900 the header class was m-header and the page's fixedPos flag null.

![phone home, full page](https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/capture/pages/m_zh-cn_main/mobile-full.png)

**RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — Phone pages replace paging with load-more lists, stack the sliders vertically and keep the same record shapes; the section number block (m-section-nav) and the back control are shared pieces.

## 29 Buttons and controls inventory

_Chapter 29 · 1 observed · 0 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

| Class | Role | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| nav-content | header entry (div, click → router push) | header |
| nav-content-sub-item | more-menu link | header |
| m-audio-player.header__bgm | background music toggle | header |
| share__icon | share panel trigger (hover) | header |
| login__icon | account iframe trigger | header |
| sidebar__pagers-num | section number (01–06) | home |
| sidebar__nav-prev / sidebar__nav-next | section arrows | home |
| home-kv__play | PV play | home |
| home-kv__download | download block (SDK platform list) | home |
| home-character__nav-item | character thumbnail | home |
| swiper-button-prev / swiper-button-next | carousel arrows (Swiper) | home, world, feature |
| more-btn | 查看更多 (router push) | home |
| home-video__nav-item | video thumbnail | home |
| home-video__action-icon | play (opens video-dialog) | home |
| swiper-pagination-bullet | carousel bullet | home, news, video |
| section__concept-video-play | concept video play | home |
| backTop | back to top | every page |
| me-media-icon-item | social link (footer SDK) | every page |
| me-hover-btn.copy-btn | copy link | every page |
| locale-selector-3HQCGC | language picker (footer SDK) | every page |
| cha-pagination-item | character pagination | character |
| character-voice-btn | voice play | character |
| character-voice-lang-switcher | voice language | character |
| side-camp-item / side-camp-expand-btn | faction filter / expand | character |
| video-tab__item / news-tab__item | category tab (nuxt-link with ?category) | video, news |
| mihoyo-pager-rich__button / __prev / __next | pager | video, news |
| video-list__item | opens the video dialog | video |
| news-list__item-banner | opens the article (router push) | news |
| news-detail-back | 返回 BACK | article |
| world__slide | opens the world entry | world |
| m-header__menu-btn / m-header__menu-close | phone menu | phone pages |

**OBSERVED** — Buttons are divs or anchors with cursor:pointer; the only  elements are the backTop button and the SDK forms. The pager and the tabs are the only controls that are real links (nuxt-link → ), which is why they survive without JavaScript as URLs.

## 34 Responsive behaviour: two trees, four media queries, measured widths

_Chapter 34 · 1 observed · 1 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

**OBSERVED** — The stylesheets contain only 4 media query contexts: @media screen and (orientation:landscape) (6 rules); @media (max-width: 1024px) (4 rules); @media (max-width: 374px) (1 rules); @media (max-width: 300px) (1 rules). Responsiveness is not done with breakpoints: the desktop tree scales every rem with the viewport (clamped at 1440) and the phone tree is a separate layout at designWidth 750; (orientation:landscape) rules adjust the phone pages when the device is turned.

## 39 Build a child site: the transferable rules

_Chapter 39 · 0 observed · 0 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

| # | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Delivery: an SPA shell served for every path (with a static loader inside it), one webpack runtime, two vendor bundles, one app bundle, route chunks on demand, CSS injected per component, SDK scripts loaded before the app. |
| 2 | Scale: author in rem on a 2560-wide desktop canvas and a 750-wide phone canvas; html font-size = 100 × clientWidth ÷ designWidth, clamped to [1440, 2560] on desktop; hide the root until the first value is set. |
| 3 | Trees: a desktop route tree and a phone route tree with the same names (m- prefix), chosen by user agent in the shell, sharing the store, the API client and the dictionaries. |
| 4 | Data: one content API with getContentList / getContent / getChildTree, channel ids as configuration, records with sTitle / sIntro / sContent (HTML) / sExt (JSON of named images) / dates / iInfoId; lists page at 7, 9, 10, 50 or 200 as the component needs. |
| 5 | Chrome: a fixed 1rem header with a 19.2rem wrapper (logo, five nav entries, more-menu, download, music, share, account); a fixed sidebar pager on the home page; a three-part footer (own social bar + back-to-top, subscription SDK, corporate footer SDK with the language picker). |
| 6 | Home: six full compositions (KV + download, characters, videos, news, world, feature) each built from one or two Swiper instances (fade for the stage, slidesPerView auto for strips, loop for banners), a sidebar that both drives and follows the scroll. |
| 7 | Inner pages: fade stage + pagination + voice player + faction rail (character); latest slider + tabs (?category) + 9-per-page grid + pager (video and news); a 12.8rem reading column with a back control and an info bar (article); a looped slide deck with slideToTop entrances (world); a document template with a pdf viewer fallback (company). |
| 8 | Tokens: ink #222122 on #e8e8e8/#efefef, black panels, accent #d8fa00 (hover #c6e800), white on dark; display faces per language with a language font variable; sizes .16–.46rem; spacing in tenths of a rem; z-index 99 for page chrome, SDK overlays above. |
| 9 | Motion: 0.3 s entrances (Vue transitions), Swiper 300 ms slides, 800 ms world slides, 20 s marquee, 0.5 s loader loop; hover = scale 1.1–1.12 or colour inversion only. |
| 10 | Audio: one looping background track behind a persisted mute toggle; per-record voice clips with a progress ring. |
| 11 | Services you must replace: the content API (host it yourself with the same shapes), the account SDK, the subscription widget, analytics and APM, the download platform list; everything else is a file and is archived on this host. |

## 40 Interactions measured live: clicks, hovers, scroll, keyboard, resize, real-time calculation

_Chapter 40 · 0 observed · 0 measured · 0 inferred · 0 rules_

Everything in this chapter was driven in headless Chromium by [tools/capture-interactions.mjs](https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/tools/capture-interactions.mjs) on 2026-10-03 and recorded in [capture/interactions.json](https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/capture/interactions.json). Each row is a real event sent to the live page and the state read back afterwards (route, store, Swiper indexes, computed styles, inline-style mutations, media calls). Where an event produced no change in headless Chromium the row says so; nothing is inferred from the code alone.

### A. Root font-size (the rem canvas) per viewport

## 41 Originals archive and self-contained mirror: the real files, data and pages on this host

_Chapter 41 · 3 observed · 1 measured · 2 inferred · 1 rules_

Everything the chapters describe can be opened in its original form on this host. The archive holds, verbatim and with SHA-256 digests, every file the depth-1 pages load (desktop and phone trees), every answer the CMS API gave the pages plus every list page and record those lists name, and the SDK scripts; the mirror serves the original application from those files. Together they close the gaps a document alone cannot: the backend answers, the media, the compiled source and the parts a headless capture could not render are here as files, not descriptions.

### A. What is archived

**OBSERVED** — Archived on 2026-10-04: 1398 files (452.3 MB), 120 CMS answers covering 81 news records and 3 world entries; 751 of the 1599 media files named by the archived records are included and 376 were left on the CDN by the size budget. The site's own build files live at /_nuxt/ under their original names (chunks, fonts, images), every other host under archive/files//…; each entry in archive/index.json carries its URL, size and SHA-256.

**INFERRED** — What cannot be archived: the per-session answers of the SDK services (ip_location, device fingerprint, cookie-token verification, subscription state, event and APM logging). The mirror lets those calls go to their hosts, where the browser blocks them for a foreign origin exactly as on the local mirror; a child site replaces them with its own consent, login and analytics.

### C. The mirror

**OBSERVED** — The mirror is the archived shell served at every route of both trees (— pages: the five sections, the company documents, — archived articles and — world entries, plus 404.html so the SPA router answers any other path), with two changes made only in the document head: the CDN references in the shell point at the archive, and one adapter script (mirror/adapter.js) answers the CMS API from the archive, serves i18n JSON and archived media from this host, and lets anything not archived reach its original URL. — CMS answers and — SDK files are served from rewritten copies under mirror/ (media URLs pointed at the archive); the originals stay untouched. Routes: /zh-cn/main, /zh-cn/character, /zh-cn/video, /zh-cn/news, /zh-cn/world, /zh-cn/company/privacy, /zh-cn/company/terms, /m/zh-cn/main.

**MEASURED** — tools/verify-mirror.mjs loaded the mirror from a plain static server: 15 of 15 checks passed — ✓ home: loader finished from the archive; ✓ home: header, six sections and footer rendered; ✓ home: CMS API answered from this host (no request reached sg-public-api-static); ✓ home: nothing fetched from the live CDN or the live site; ✓ home: character and video swipers populated; ✓ client navigation to the character page (router push, no reload); ✓ news index: list, tabs and pager from the archive; ✓ news index: second tab answered from the archive; ✓ article 166535: renders its archived record; ✓ article 166535: images served from this host where archived; ✓ world page: slides from the archive; ✓ handbook route /zh-cn/news/7013 renders the handbook inside the news template; ✓ mobile tree: /m/zh-cn/main renders the mobile home from the archive; ✓ no JavaScript errors from the site code; ✓ no missing files on this host.

```
// mirror adapter, excerpt — mirror/adapter.js (built by tools/build-mirror.mjs)
const canonical = u => { const x = new URL(u, location.href); const q = [...x.searchParams.entries()].sort(…).map(([k, v]) => k + '=' + v).join('&'); return x.host + x.pathname + (q ? '?' + q : ''); };
const answer = u => { const k = canonical(u); for (const [re, file] of Object.entries(OVERRIDE)) if (new RegExp(re).test(k)) return file; return API[k] || null; };
XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (m, u, ...r) { if (m === 'GET') { const a = answer(u); if (a) u = location.origin + a; else { const l = localFile(u); if (l) u = l; } } return open.call(this, m, u, ...r); };
// this handbook page: window.__MIRROR_OVERRIDE = { 'getContent\\?.*iInfoId=7013': '/handbook/handbook-content.json' }
```

### D. What this changes for a child site

**RULE FOR A CHILD SITE** — Build the backend to answer the archived requests in the archived shapes (archive/api/index.json is the contract), serve media from your own CDN with the same record fields, keep the SDK calls behind your own consent and login, and use the mirror as the reference rendering: open a mirrored page and a child page side by side at 1440 × 900 and at 390 × 844 and compare.

**INFERRED** — With the archive and the mirror on the same host as this handbook, the only things a reader cannot take from here are HoYoverse's live services and the rights to the material: everything that can be a file is a file.

```css
.logoBig-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.7s ease,
    transform 0.7s ease;
  transform-origin: top left;
}
.logoBig-enter,
.logoBig-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.28);
}
.logoBig-leave,
.logoBig-enter-to {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}
.logoSmall-enter-active,
.logoSmall-leave-active {
  transition: opacity 0.7s ease;
}
.logoSmall-enter,
.logoSmall-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}
.logoSmall-leave,
.logoSmall-enter-to {
  opacity: 1;
}
```

```css
.backTop {

  width: 1.6rem;

  background: no-repeat top center/contain;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  transition: all 0.2s ease-out;
  opacity: 0;
  cursor: auto;

  cursor: pointer;

  }
}
```

```css
.hyv-subscription-modal__close {
  -webkit-box-pack: center;
  -ms-flex-pack: center;
  -webkit-box-align: center;
  -ms-flex-align: center;
  align-items: center;

}
.hyv-crm-modal__close .hyv-icon-close,
.hyv-subscription-modal__close .hyv-icon-close {
  fill: currentColor;
  color: var(--global-text-body);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.22em;
}
[hyv-device^="mobile"] .hyv-crm-modal__close,
[hyv-device^="mobile"] .hyv-subscription-modal__close {
  bottom: calc(83vh - 0.45em);
  position: fixed;
  right: 0.04em;

}

  [hyv-device^="mobile"] .hyv-crm-modal__close,

}

}

.hyv-subscription-title {

.hyv-subscription-desc {

.hyv-subscription-modal__question .hyv-subscription-bottom-empty,

.sub-view-leave,

  display: none;

.sub-view-enter-active,
.sub-view-leave-active {
  -webkit-transition: all 0.3s linear;
  transition: all 0.3s linear;
}
```

```css
.m-web-protocol {
  margin: 1.1rem auto 0;
  min-height: 100%;
}
.m-web-protocol.fromGame {
  width: 80%;
}
.m-web-protocol-container {
  padding: 0.9rem 0.4rem;
  text-align: center;
}
.m-web-protocol__article {
  position: relative;
  text-align: left;
}
.m-web-protocol__title {
  font-size: 0.42rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-align: center;
  color: #222122;
}
.m-web-protocol__info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  height: 0.64rem;
  padding: 0 0.24rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  font-size: 0.24rem;
  color: #fff;
  background-color: #222122;
  border-radius: 0.32rem;
}
.m-web-protocol__info .breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
.m-web-protocol__info .news-tag {
  font-size: 0.24rem;
  color: #fff;
}
.m-web-protocol__content {
  font-size: 0.26rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #222122;
}
.m-web-protocol__content .table-wrapper {
  overflow: auto;
}
.m-web-protocol__content img,
.m-web-protocol__content video {
  max-width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
}
.m-web-protocol__content img {
  display: inline-block;
}
.m-web-protocol__content table,
.m-web-protocol__content td {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: solid 1px #c2c2c2;
}
.m-web-protocol__content td {
  padding-left: 10px;
}
.m-web-protocol__content td p {
  text-align: inherit;
  max-width: 90%;
}
.m-web-protocol__content td a {
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.m-web-protocol__content a {
  max-width: 100%;
  word-break: break-word;
}
.m-web-protocol__foot {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.9rem;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 0;
}
.m-web-protocol__back {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 2.42rem;
  height: 0.82rem;
  padding: 0 0.14rem;
  background: #000;
  border: 0.08rem solid #767678;
  border-radius: 0.42rem;
  font-size: 0.28rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #fff;
}
.m-web-protocol__back::after {
  margin-left: 0.26rem;
  font-size: 0.18rem;
  font-family: "icomoon", sans-serif !important;
  content: "";
  color: #d6d6d6;
  transform: rotate(-180deg);
}
```

```css
@keyframes slideToTop {
  0% {
    transform: translateY(100%);

  }
  100% {
    transform: translateY(0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
```

```css
  100% {
    transform: translateX(-400%);
  }
}
@keyframes slideRight {
  100% {
    transform: translateX(400%);
  }
}
@keyframes slideNextRight {
  100% {
    transform: translateX(400%) rotate(180deg);
  }
}

}
.slide-fade-leave-active {
  transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(1, 0.5, 0.8, 1);

.slide-fade-leave-to {
```

### B.1 analytics-plugin

_analytics-plugin.327.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/analytics-plugin.327.js · chunk 8c4c131 · 98 lines · 24 identifiers renamed_

Nuxt client plugin that sets up analytics. It initializes Google Analytics (module 897, measurement id `G-8BR44XDKVQ`) and `window.miHoYoAnalysis` (appId 262, isSea/environment from the env config, `dataBelong: ['nap']`, deviceType from `$flex`, plat 1/2/3 for Android/iOS/PC), falling back to a console-warning stub when the SDK is missing, stores it as `window.mhyAna`, and injects `$trackEvent`, `$updateUid` and `$trackButton` (which prefixes `Button`, `Click` to the tracked event arguments).

```js
/**
 * analytics-plugin — readable reconstruction of webpack module 327 (chunk 8c4c131.js)
 * Original: https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/_nuxt/8c4c131.js
 *
 * Nuxt client plugin that sets up analytics. It initializes Google Analytics (module 897, measurement id `G-8BR44XDKVQ`) and `window.miHoYoAnalysis` (appId 262, isSea/environment from the env config, `dataBelong: ['nap']`, deviceType from `$flex`, plat 1/2/3 for Android/iOS/PC), falling back to a console-warning stub when the SDK is missing, stores it as `window.mhyAna`, and injects `$trackEvent`, `$updateUid` and `$trackButton` (which prefixes `Button`, `Click` to the tracked event arguments).
 *
 * Exports (minified key → meaning):
```

### B.9 base

_base.251.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/base.251.js · chunk 8c4c131 · 126 lines · 12 identifiers renamed_

Renderless `base` Vue mixin component shared by page components. It exposes computed accessors over the Vuex store (`baseConfig`, `lang`, `mi18n`, `userInfo` with the `setUserInfo` mutation, `baseInfo` with the `setBaseInfo` mutation) and the build `environment` from the env config module, and methods: `getWelcomeText` (picks welcome survey/submit/detail i18n texts from `baseInfo.survey_flag`/`reserve_flag`), an async `logout` (calls `$accountRoleUtil.logout()`, clears userInfo, tracks `SDK_Logout` via `$trackEvent`, reloads the page), `onLogin` (stores user info and enables `canClick`) and `handleError` (toasts the API `message` or the `code-500` i18n text via `$mtoast`).

### B.11 character

_character.1439.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/character.1439.js · chunk 3f59e77 · 1358 lines · 123 identifiers renamed_

Nuxt page component `character` for the desktop character route `lang-character` (`scrollToTop`). `asyncData` loads the camp list (`getCampList`, channel `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.CHARACTER.CAMP`) and all characters (`getAllCharacter`) from the character API (module 1154), redirects to `main` when there are none, commits `setCharacterCamps`, pads `renderCampList` to a multiple of 4 with empty camps, and derives `activeIndex`, `chaList`, `curActiveCha`/`curActiveChaIdx` from `query.id` plus a lazy fade `chaSwiperOption`; `head()` builds title and description/og/twitter meta from the active character's `sTitle` and `word`. It renders the desktop `pageTab` (nav-num 2, themed), a client-only fade vue-awesome-swiper (ref `chaSwiper`) of lazy `character-cover` slides with `character-info` (level icon, name, `Mont-Heavy` English name scaled by `updateEnNameScale`, a `character-voice-player`, prop icons, `character-info-word` and a `vue-scroll` (vuescroll) intro), a 3-per-view `cha-pagination-swiper` with arrow buttons, a vertical looped `side-camp-swiper` whose sticky position/height `updateSideCampStyle` recomputes on window `resize`/`scroll`, a `character-camp-selection` overlay (`selection__*`, animated by a `$gsap` timeline) and hidden SEO `character-detail-link` nuxt-links. Voice playback uses `eventAudio` from module 354 with a looping `$gsap` `--progress` mic animation, `loadEnFont` loads the `Mont-Heavy` FontFace from modules 558/559, `preloadImages` calls the swiper `lazy.loadInSlide`, and the `curActiveCha` watcher syncs the swiper and `$router.replace`s `query.id`; clicks are tracked with `$trackButton` (`character_voice`, `camp_change`, `view_all_camp`/`all_camp_back`).

### B.21 footer-bar

_footer-bar.203.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/footer-bar.203.js · chunk 8c4c131 · 230 lines · 14 identifiers renamed_

Vue component `footer-bar`, the site footer. On mount it initializes the external `window.HYVFooter` widget on `#footer` (biz `nap_global`, locale from `$store.state.lang`, supported locales from `HoYoverseMi18n.d`, selector hidden on `$isBBS`) and on language change collapses the footer, calls `setLang`, commits the `setLang` mutation and reloads the page with the language segment replaced in the URL. It renders `.footer` / `.footer__wrap` with a `backTop` button on the main/news routes, a `.footer__socialbar` with `media-icon` (bound to `$store.getters.mediaConfig`, tracking follows via `$trackButton('go_media', ...)`) and a `hover-btn.copy-btn` that copies the `shareCopyText` via `$clipboard` and toasts with `$mtoast`, plus a `.footer-crm` `crm-sub` subscription widget (shown unless `$store.state.isEnIp`, i18n key `m20231213hy4784y0w0`, event key `nap_official_crm`).

### B.22 global-Vue-plugins-and

_global-Vue-plugins-and.343.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/global-Vue-plugins-and.343.js · chunk 8c4c131 · 104 lines · 6 identifiers renamed_

Nuxt plugin that installs the site's global Vue extensions exactly once (guarded by a module-level flag). Vue component `header-bar`, the desktop site header; it extends the `base` mixin and registers `headerSocial`. On mount it creates a `window.MeSeaDownload.DownloadCore` instance (gameBiz `nap_global`, type `fab`, source `262`) used by the download nav button; left navs come from `HoYoverseMi18n.e` (minus `feature`) plus a `menu_more_label` group of exchange/top_up/community external links resolved via `$getI18nWord`. It renders `header.header` / `.header-wrapper` with the `.header__logo` (big/small logos switched by `$store.state.homeSection` on `lang-main`), `.header__navbar-links` / `.header__navbar-link(--active)` items with `.nav-content-sub` dropdowns, `.header__navbar-btns` with the download button, a `me-audio` `.header__bgm` BGM player (volume from `$store.state.bgmMuted`, storage key `napSeaBgAudio`), `header-social`, a `.login` block with `.login__dropdown` and logout, and a hidden `account-role` component. It reads `$store.state.lang`/`userInfo`, commits `setUserInfo` and `setRoutePage`, navigates to `lang-&lt;link&gt;` routes with lodash `_.omit` query cleanup, and tracks via `$trackEvent`/`$trackButton`.

Vue component `header-social`, the share/follow popover in the header. It renders `.share` &gt; `.share__info` with a `.share__icon` trigger and, client-only, a `.share__panel` / `.share__panel-wrap` containing a `.share__title` (`socialFollow` i18n text) and a `.share__list` with `media-icon` bound to `$store.getters.mediaConfig` plus a `hover-btn.copy-btn` in the `extra-media-end` slot. Methods track `Media_Share`, `Media_Sub_Follow` and `Media_Sub_Share` via `$trackButton`, and the copy button copies `shareCopyText` with `$clipboard` and shows `copySuccess` via `$mtoast`.

### B.27 HoYoverse-OSS-file-upload-SDK

_HoYoverse-OSS-file-upload-SDK.531.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/HoYoverse-OSS-file-upload-SDK.531.js · chunk be1f69b · 1228 lines · 339 identifiers renamed_

Bundled HoYoverse/miHoYo OSS file-upload SDK (a self-contained webpack bundle with its own module runtime, depending on a SparkMD5 module and a file-encryption module). `ossFileUpload(options)` validates `env`, computes the file MD5 by reading 2MB chunks with `FileReader` + `SparkMD5.ArrayBuffer`, requests upload parameters from one of many takumi / sg-public-op / sg-public-api endpoints (e.g. `/upload/op/getParamsByOp`, `/upload/outer/getParamsByAccount`, `/upload/outer/GetParamsByAuthKey`, `/mupload/minio/getToken`) selected by inland/overseas, inner/outer, AWS (`s3`), login type and environment, then uploads via XHR as an OSS POST form (OSSAccessKeyId/policy/signature), an S3/SGW `PUT` with signed headers, or a private MinIO form; it also supports fetching remote URLs (`/upload/op/fetch`), optional client-side encryption (`encryptFromFile`), progress callbacks, `x-rpc-language`/`X-Rpc-App_key` headers and an optional watermark call to `/upload/op/watermark`. `ossFileBatchUpload` uploads multiple files to inland, overseas (`os`) or `both` areas and reports success/error lists, and the default export also provides a Vue `install` adding `$OssFileUpload`/`$OssFileBatchUpload`.

Nuxt page component for the desktop world-entry detail route `lang-world-id` (`scrollToTop`). `validate` only accepts numeric `params.id`; `asyncData` loads the entry via the world API (module 1152) `getDetail` (`/getContent`, channel `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.WORLD`) with `iInfoId: params.id` and `sLangKey: store.state.lang`, raising a Nuxt 404 `error` on failure, and exposes it as `worldContent` (its `sTitle` plus i18n `seoTitlePrefix` is the `head()` title). It renders `world-detail` with the desktop `pageTab` (nav-num 5), a `world-detail__back` `nuxt-link` to `lang-world` with `params.worldId`, and a `world-detail__article` (ref `desc`) holding `scaleIn` transitions around a client-only vue-awesome-swiper (ref `worldSwiper`, `.swiper-pagination` plus `.swiper-button-prev/next`, shown when `banner` has more than one image) of `banner` images whose click calls `gotoDetail`, the entry title and HTML `sContent`. A `world-detail__more` toggle (i18n `learnMore`/`textFold`) runs `handleMore`, which expands the article to `height: auto` or collapses it back to `8.5rem` and scrolls the window to the top with jQuery `$(window).scrollTop(0)`.

### B.43 m-cha

_m-cha.1423.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/m-cha.1423.js · chunk 564bae5 · 1079 lines · 94 identifiers renamed_

Nuxt page component `m-cha` for the mobile character route `m-lang-character` (layout `m/default`, `scrollToTop`). `asyncData` loads the camp list (`getCampList`, channel `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.CHARACTER.CAMP`) and all characters (`getAllCharacter`) from the character API (module 1154), redirects to `m` when there are none, commits `setCharacterCamps`, and derives `activeIndex` (camp) and `curActiveChaIdx` from `query.id`, plus a fade-effect `chaSwiperOpts`; `head()` builds title and description/og/twitter meta from the active character's `sTitle` and `word`. It renders the mobile `pageTab` (nav-num 2, themed by `themeColor`), a fade vue-awesome-swiper (ref `chaSwiperRef`) of `character-swiper-slide` covers with `character-info` (prop/level icons, name, a `character-voice-player` with CV name and language switcher, and a `vue-scroll` (vuescroll) description), prev/next `switch-button`s, a horizontally scrolling `character-pagination`, the active `character-camp` button and a `character-camp-selection` overlay animated with a `$gsap` timeline, plus hidden SEO `character-detail-link` nuxt-links. Voice playback uses `eventAudio` from module 354 (stop/unload/switchSrcIndex/play, `$mtoast` i18n `textSoon` when empty) with a looping `$gsap` `--progress` mic animation; the `curActiveCha` watcher rebuilds the audio, scrolls the pagination via `$flex('rem')`, syncs the swiper and `$router.replace`s `query.id`, and clicks are tracked with `$trackButton` (`character_voice`, `view_all_camp`/`all_camp_back`, `camp_change`).

Nuxt page component `m-feature` for the mobile route `m-lang-feature` (layout `m/default`). `asyncData` calls the Nuxt `redirect` to `m-lang-main` unconditionally and also loads the feature list via the home content API (module 1164) `getFeature` (`/getContentList`, channel `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.FEATURE`) with `sLangKey: store.state.lang`, exposing it as `featureList`; `created` sets `activeFeature` to the first entry. Vue component `m-header-bar`, the mobile site header. It extends the shared `base` mixin, registers `headerSocial`, builds its nav list from `HoYoverseMi18n.e` plus i18n-driven extra links (exchange/top_up/community under a `menu_more_label` group and `menu_care_link`), and renders `.m-header` with the logo (`.m-header__logo`, `.logo-icon`, `.logoSmall-img`), a download button (`.m-header__download` calling `$downloadIns.download()`), a `me-audio` BGM player (`.m-header__bgm`, storageKey `napSeaBgAudio`), a slide-in menu panel (`.m-header__menu`, `.m-header__menu-link`, `.nav-content-sub`) and login/user info blocks (`.header-user-info`, `.header-login-btn`). It reads `$store.state.lang`, `bgmMuted`, `homeSection`, commits `muteBgm`, navigates via `$router.push({ name: 'm-lang-&lt;link&gt;' })`, tracks clicks with `$trackEvent`/`$trackButton`, uses lodash `_.omit`, `$clipboard`, `$mtoast`, `$mJump` and `$accountRoleUtil.show()`, and toggles `showMenuBtn`/`isStartScroll` from the window scroll position.

### B.55 m-lang-video

_m-lang-video.1419.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/m-lang-video.1419.js · chunk a9873dc · 2343 lines · 165 identifiers renamed_

Nuxt page component `m-index` for the mobile home route `m-lang-main` (layout `m/default`), bundled with its inline section components: the KV (`m-home-kv`, plays the `youtobeUrl` PV in `videoDialog` via `$openDialog` while committing `muteBgm`, tracking `AppointPage_PV_start/stop`), the video section (`m-home-video`, swiper of `videoRes` covers with prev/next, category label from `getCateDisplayName`, `learnMore` link to `m-lang-video`), the character section (`m-home-character`, thumb + fade swipers, camp info from the `characterCamps` getter or `getCampList` -&gt; `setCharacterCamps`, `learnMore` to `m-lang-character`), the news slider (`m-home-news`, autoplaying looped swiper with `swiper-pagination-index-N` bullets and a scrolling summary), the feature section (`m-home-feature`, fade swiper with `feat-swiper-button-*`) and the world section (`m-home-world`, banners linking to `m-lang-world` plus the i18n `conceptLink` concept-video card), and an `m-preregister` floating bar with download / cloud-download buttons (`$downloadIns.download()`, `$mJump` to the iOS/Android cloud link, `$trackEvent`). The page's `asyncData` fetches in parallel `getKV`/`getFeature` (module 1164), `getSliderNews` (1124), `getAllCharacter` (1154), `getWorldList` (1152), `getHomeVideoList` and `getCates` (1153), commits `setVideoCates`/`setVideoMainChanName`, filters out `news-self-path` news (max 6) and returns `kvRes`, `newsRes`, `characterRes`, `featureRes`, `worldRes` and `videoRes`. It renders `section-index/character/video/news/world/feature` blocks with `fill` decoration static renders, keeps `isLoading` bound to the store (`setLoading`), positions the pre-register bar from scroll/resize, registers `$gsap` ScrollTrigger timelines that `$trackEvent('Page','enter')` per `.section`, and `slideTo` scrolls to a section using the nav config from HoYoverse mi18n (module 49).

Bundled `@me/toast` library (UMD factory called with webpack exports, core-js-pure/Babel runtime helpers, Vue and a shared utils module providing `IS_MOB` and `asyncTimeout`). It defines the `Toast` Vue component (props `duration`, `message`, `showContent`, `zIndex`, `opacity`, `isLoading`, `setInnerHtml`, `blockEvent`, `el`) rendering `.me-toast` with `me-toast__m`/`__pc`/`__pc__2k` and `__enter`/`__leave` modifiers, a loading `.me-toast-content__loading` block with an SVG `.me-toast__spinner`, or a `transition-group` of `.me-toast-content__toast` messages (`.me-toast-message`) that auto-remove after their duration; its scoped CSS (`data-v-634288c8_0`) is injected by an embedded style injector and `normalizeComponent`. A singleton toast manager mounts instances via `Vue.extend` into `document.body` or a given element and exposes `Toast(msg|options)` with `.loading`, `.clear`, `.allowToastMultiple` and `.disableToastMultiple`; the default export is a plugin whose `install(Vue, commonOptions)` sets `Vue.prototype.$mtoast`.

### B.61 mhy-copy-input-clipboard-helper

_mhy-copy-input-clipboard-helper.535.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/mhy-copy-input-clipboard-helper.535.js · chunk be1f69b · 134 lines · 29 identifiers renamed_

Bundled `mhy-copy-input` clipboard helper (a self-contained webpack bundle with its own module runtime). Its default export `clipboard({ text, onSuccess, onFail })` creates a temporary read-only `input.mhy-copy-input` (font-size 14px) holding the text, selects it, runs `document.execCommand('copy')` (throwing when `queryCommandSupported('copy')` is false), removes the input and calls `onSuccess` or `onFail`; its `install(Vue)` method sets `Vue.prototype.$clipboard`.

Nuxt page component `news` for the desktop news-list route `lang-news`. `asyncData` reads the cached `newsCache.pageIndex` (then resets it with `setNewsCache`) and loads, via the news API (module 1124), the slider news (`getSliderNews`), the category tree (`getCates`, `/getChildTree` under `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.NEWS.ALL`) and a 9-item page of `getAllNews` for `query.category`, all honoring the `blockGachaAnnounce` getter; it commits `setNewsCates` and returns `latestNewsList` (first 6), `cates`, `initPage`, `newsList` and `total`. It renders div.page-protocol with &lt;header-bar&gt;, div.web-protocol &gt; .web-protocol-container &gt; .web-protocol__article holding .web-protocol__title, a .web-protocol__info breadcrumb (i18n gameName &gt; title) and .web-protocol__content via innerHTML, a .backContainer with &lt;backTop theme=&quot;reverse&quot;&gt;, then &lt;footer-bar&gt;. Normalised with componentNormalizer (module 36); styles from module 1139.

Bundled `@me/audio` library (UMD factory called with webpack exports and core-js-pure/Babel runtime helpers, howler, a shared utils module and Vue). It defines an `AudioPlayer` class wrapping `Howl` instances (multi-src index switching, sprites, fade in/out, volume change, play/pause/stop/unload, play state cached in `storage` under `storageKey` default `@me/audio`, pause on page `visibilitychange`, and an html5 first-click autoplay unlock with iOS 15 detection) and the `MeAudio` Vue component (props `src`, `effectSrc`, `effectConfig`, `index`, `loop`, `icon`/`activeIcon`/`hoverIcon`, `volume`, `autoplay`, `preload`, `fade`, `doPlay`, `html5`, `cache`, `storageKey`) that renders `.m-audio-player` with `.m-audio-player__icon` (`--hover`, `--active`) images, emits `tap`/`played`/`end`, and exposes `Vue.prototype.$effectPlayer` for sound effects. It includes the vue-runtime-helpers `normalizeComponent` and a browser style injector for its scoped CSS (`data-v-201c2d6f_0`).

### B.86 sidebar

_sidebar.1418.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/sidebar.1418.js · chunk 3b23566 · 3564 lines · 248 identifiers renamed_

Nuxt page component `index` for the desktop home route `lang-main` (layout `default`), bundled with its inline children: the `sidebar` section pager (prev/next and `0N` numbers from the HoYoverse mi18n nav config `Navs`, translateY by a measured nav height, emits `toSection`), a `cloud-download-dialog` (QR code and Windows/macOS cloud-download buttons via `$mJump`, `popup_download` events), the KV (`home-kv`, extends `base`; PV playback in `videoDialog` with `muteBgm`, PC download via `addParamsToUrl(pc_download_link)` + `$ads` FB/Twitter tracking, Steam wishlist link, `sea-download-layout` platform buttons using `window.MeSeaDownload.getDownloadMi18n` for `layer_tag`, cloud download, and an optional Firebase web-push subscribe button using `initializeApp`/messaging `getToken` with a VAPID key and the `webpush_subscribe` storage flag), the character section (`home-character`, thumb + fade swipers, sliding English-name marquee via `$gsap`, camps from the `characterCamps` getter or `getCampList` -&gt; `setCharacterCamps`), the news slider (`home-news`), feature (`home-feature`), world (`home-world` with the concept-video card) and video (`home-video`, fade swiper with a translating thumbnail nav, throttled prev/next and debounced resize) sections. The page's `asyncData` fetches `getKV`/`getFeature` (module 1164), `getSliderNews` (1124), `getAllCharacter` (1154), `getWorldList` (1152), `getHomeVideoList` and `getCates` (1153), commits `setVideoCates`/`setVideoMainChanName`, keeps up to 6 non-`news-self-path` news and returns `kvRes`, `newsRes`, `characterRes`, `featureRes`, `worldRes` and `videoRes`. It renders `section-index/character/video/news/world/feature` blocks with `fill` decorations, tracks the active section from scroll (`setHomeSection`, `$trackEvent('Page','enter')`), restores `homeScroll` / saves it with `setHomeScroll`, scrolls between sections with `$gsap` `scrollTo`, and registers per-section `$gsap` ScrollTrigger timelines that slide in `.section-nav-*` labels and animate mi18n-configured attributes.

User-model HTTP request layer. It exports get/post/put/del, each calling a shared request(method, url, options, formatParams, formatResult) that normalises options (data, preParams, cache, loading, success, error, download, response), adds isPreview/prerelease/timestamp in the &quot;prerelease&quot; environment, forwards authkey query params, serves GET responses from the response cache (module 1240) or merges duplicate in-flight GETs (module 1241), and otherwise calls axios (module 114, or nuxtContext.$axios from module 500 when appBundle.axiosType is &quot;nuxt&quot;) with baseURL appBundle.apiBase. It manages a global loading overlay via a memory Store counter (isRequestingCount / hideDefaultLoadingTimer, module 1176) and the defaults facade (module 1244), shows success/warn/error messages, treats retcode -100 (not logged in) and -403 (no permission) specially, and supports download via module 1243; it also exports identity defaultFormatParams/formatParams/formatResult/defaultFormatResult and requestIsSucc.

Desktop video-list page for the route `lang-video` (component name `lang-video`, layout `default`), bundled with an inline `video-tag` child component. `video-tag` takes a `channel` prop and shows a `video-tag__text` label from the video API (module 1153) `getCateDisplayName`, using the `videoCates`/`videoMainChanName` getters and, when they are empty, fetching `getCates` and committing `setVideoCates`/`setVideoMainChanName`. The page's `asyncData` loads `getSliderVideos`, `getCates` and a 9-item `getAllVideos` page for `query.category` (default `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.VIDEO.ALL`), commits the parsed categories and returns `latestVideoList` (first 6), `cates` (`tabCates`), `videoList` and `total`. It renders the desktop `pageTab` (nav-num 3), a `video-slider` (i18n `navVideoLabel`) with the latest videos as a list (fewer than 3) or a looped vue-awesome-swiper (ref `mySwiper`) with `swiper-pagination-index-N` bullets tracked as `video_point`, a `video-wrap` of `video-tab` category links (`/&lt;lang&gt;/video?category=...`, keeping `shareType`, tracked as `navigation_videos`), a `video-list` of cover/date/`video-tag`/title items and a `mihoyo-pager-rich` pager (module 1174) driving `renderPage` (re-fetch with `cache: true`, jQuery scroll to `.video-wrap`). Clicking a video calls `openPlayer`, which opens `videoDialog` (module 1157) via `$openDialog` with a YouTube iframe or `videoUrl` source and tracks `video_pics`.

### B.107 world

_world.1441.js · https://sitedna.zenlesszonezero.calyndrae.com/source/readable/world.1441.js · chunk 1e69d9d · 434 lines · 42 identifiers renamed_

Nuxt page component `world` for the desktop world-archive route `lang-world`. `asyncData` loads entries via the world API (module 1152) `getWorldList` (channel `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.WORLD`) with `sLangKey: store.state.lang`, redirects to `lang-main` when the list is empty, and returns `worldList` plus the `activeIndex` matching `params.worldId`; `mounted` runs `initSwiper` (re-mounts the swiper at `initialSlide = activeIndex` and starts `isInitAnim`). It renders the desktop `pageTab` (nav-num 5) and a client-only looped vue-awesome-swiper coverflow (ref `worldSwiper`, no touch move, speed 800) whose `progress` handler applies `translateX(...rem) scale(...)`/opacity per slide, `transitionStart` re-stacks z-indexes when `dir` is `next`, `slideChange` stores `activeIndex`, and `click` on the active slide calls `gotoDetail`; each `world__slide` shows a cover with `name-en`/`name` (`data-lang`, hidden when `isEN`), `cover-summary` and `world__slide-tape`, plus `world__navigation` prev/next buttons that set `dir` and track `file_next`. `gotoDetail` plays the `isClickAnim` animation, waits via `asyncTimeout`, routes to `lang-world-id` and tracks `file_card` via `$trackButton`; `head()` uses i18n `nav5` + `seoTitlePrefix`.

## Acknowledgements

**Author:** Calyndrae.

HoYoverse / COGNOSPHERE are acknowledged as the owners of the Zenless Zone Zero website that is the subject of this handbook: its design, markup, stylesheets, scripts, fonts, images and sounds. Their material is reproduced here for study of the site's construction only.

The site's own libraries are acknowledged with their maintainers: Vue, Nuxt, vue-router, Vuex, vue-meta, Swiper, GSAP, axios, lodash, date-fns, vant, pdf.js, vuescroll and Firebase. Credit for those tools belongs to their respective authors; their inclusion here does not imply that they endorse this handbook.

The handbook was produced with Node.js, Playwright and headless Chromium (capture, measurement and specimen rendering), prettier and Babel (beautifying, splitting and renaming), PostCSS (stylesheet analysis), poppler (page-text extraction for the contents and index) and ReportLab (this printed edition).

The page layout, beige front matter, body pages and acknowledgements treatment are adapted from the supplied template. Its publisher did not author, publish or endorse this handbook, and no mark of theirs appears in it.

Noto Serif is used for the serif text. The template's Lucida Sans could not be embedded beyond the subset of glyphs the template itself carries, so DejaVu Sans, the closest available humanist sans, takes its role for the title, headings, contents and footer. Code is set in DejaVu Sans Mono. Chinese text in the examples is set in Noto Sans CJK where the serif face has no glyph. Tables, lists, inline identifiers and code excerpts are typeset from the handbook's own content rather than shown as raw formatting syntax.
